label: spokesperson for
definition: Person X is spokesperson for organization, office or person Y.
scope_notes: Preserves spokesperson/speak-for scope and direction. Other roles, reversed legal representation, corporate location and contest outcomes do not qualify.

facts.reason: Pearl Meyer & Partners is a firm/consultant in New York, not a spokesperson for it.
Fink is explicitly Department of Buildings spokeswoman/spokesman in several constructions.
Toronto Blue Jays have contract-offer and beat-Yankees evidence, not a spokesperson role.
Simpson has Shapiro as lawyer/counsel; legal representation is in the inverse direction and does not make Simpson Shapiro spokesperson.
Patterson is explicitly Economic Development Corporation spokeswoman/spokesman.
